CrossCameraAssociationPair.description: Typed record for a single correlated encounter pair across different cameras (Feature F06).

encounter_id_a.description: Identifier of the first encounter in the pair.
encounter_id_a.title: Encounter Id A

encounter_id_b.description: Identifier of the second encounter in the pair.
encounter_id_b.title: Encounter Id B

camera_id_a.description: Physical camera ID for encounter A.
camera_id_a.title: Camera Id A

camera_id_b.description: Physical camera ID for encounter B.
camera_id_b.title: Camera Id B

shared_taxa.description: Eligible species present in both encounters.
shared_taxa.title: Shared Taxa

observation_ids_a.description: Source observation IDs for encounter A.
observation_ids_a.title: Observation Ids A

observation_ids_b.description: Source observation IDs for encounter B.
observation_ids_b.title: Observation Ids B

detection_ids_a.description: Source detection IDs for encounter A.
detection_ids_a.title: Detection Ids A

detection_ids_b.description: Source detection IDs for encounter B.
detection_ids_b.title: Detection Ids B

effective_labels_provenance.description: Effective label resolution and provenance per detection ID.
effective_labels_provenance.title: Effective Labels Provenance

start_time_a.description: ISO 8601 start timestamp for encounter A.
start_time_a.title: Start Time A

end_time_a.description: ISO 8601 end timestamp for encounter A.
end_time_a.title: End Time A

start_time_b.description: ISO 8601 start timestamp for encounter B.
start_time_b.title: Start Time B

end_time_b.description: ISO 8601 end timestamp for encounter B.
end_time_b.title: End Time B

nominal_gap_seconds.description: Nominal temporal gap in seconds between encounter intervals: max(0, start_B - end_A, start_A - end_B).
nominal_gap_seconds.title: Nominal Gap Seconds

min_possible_gap_seconds.description: Exact attainable lower bound on temporal separation in seconds accounting for combined pairwise clock uncertainty: max(0, nominal_gap - uncertainty).
min_possible_gap_seconds.title: Min Possible Gap Seconds

max_possible_gap_seconds.description: Exact attainable upper bound on temporal separation in seconds accounting for combined pairwise clock uncertainty: max(0, (start_B - end_A) + U, (start_A - end_B) + U). Note: for overlapping intervals, G + U is an enclosure, while this field calculates the exact attainable supremum.
max_possible_gap_seconds.title: Max Possible Gap Seconds

effective_gap_seconds.description: Backward-compatible alias for min_possible_gap_seconds. Lower bound of possible gap range, NOT a definitive corrected gap.
effective_gap_seconds.title: Effective Gap Seconds

temporal_eligibility.description: Eligibility classification: 'definitely_within_threshold' if max_possible_gap <= threshold else 'possibly_within_threshold'.
temporal_eligibility.title: Temporal Eligibility

clock_offset_seconds_a.description: Applied clock offset in seconds for camera A (t_corrected = t_raw + offset).
clock_offset_seconds_a.title: Clock Offset Seconds A

clock_offset_seconds_b.description: Applied clock offset in seconds for camera B (t_corrected = t_raw + offset).
clock_offset_seconds_b.title: Clock Offset Seconds B

camera_distance_meters.description: Approximate spherical great-circle camera separation in meters if coordinates exist and are evaluated. Camera separation is not animal travel distance.
camera_distance_meters.title: Camera Distance Meters

spatial_units.description: 'meters' if camera distance was calculated, otherwise None.
spatial_units.title: Spatial Units

rule_outcomes.description: Evaluated boolean outcomes for individual association rules.
rule_outcomes.title: Rule Outcomes

disclaimer.default: Possible association only; individual animal identity and movement are not established.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

spatial_note.description: Explicit note detailing spatial evaluation status and limitations.
spatial_note.title: Spatial Note

explanation.description: Deterministic plain-language explanation of the association.
explanation.title: Explanation

clock_offsets_applied.description: Per-camera clock offsets applied in seconds (t_corrected = t_raw + offset).
clock_offsets_applied.title: Clock Offsets Applied

timestamps_pre_corrected.description: Whether timestamps were pre-corrected prior to analysis.
timestamps_pre_corrected.title: Timestamps Pre Corrected

correction_provenance.description: Documented provenance for pre-corrected timestamps or offset source.
correction_provenance.title: Correction Provenance

temporal_threshold_seconds.description: Maximum allowable temporal gap in seconds.
temporal_threshold_seconds.title: Temporal Threshold Seconds

spatial_threshold_meters.description: Maximum allowable camera distance in meters if set.
spatial_threshold_meters.title: Spatial Threshold Meters

total_eligible_encounters.description: Total encounters meeting scope and species criteria.
total_eligible_encounters.title: Total Eligible Encounters

total_matching_pairs_found.description: Total matching pairs satisfying all rules.
total_matching_pairs_found.title: Total Matching Pairs Found

is_coverage_complete.description: Whether pair evaluation was exhaustive or bounded.
is_coverage_complete.title: Is Coverage Complete

disclaimer.default: Possible association only; individual animal identity and movement are not established. Same-species sightings close in time can be coincidental.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
